name: modrixcommerce/external-storage
display_name: External Cloud Storage (Wasabi, AWS S3, Cloudflare & Multi-Cloud)
description: Automatically save product photos, product videos, and media assets directly in external cloud storage instead of locally. Supports Wasabi, AWS S3, Cloudflare R2 & Cloudflare Storage API, DigitalOcean Spaces, Backblaze B2, BunnyCDN Storage, Google Cloud Storage, MinIO, and custom APIs.
author: Modrix Commerce

permissions.name: external_storage.manage
permissions.label: Manage external cloud storage & media offloading

settings.label: Enable External Cloud Storage
settings.help: Offload and serve product photos and videos from external cloud storage.

settings.label: External Storage Provider
settings.help: Select your cloud storage provider. Once enabled, open Catalog -> External Storage for step-by-step setup documentation, bucket policy snippets, and API key configuration for each provider.

settings.label: Automatic Save Behavior
settings.help: Choose whether new product photos and videos are saved directly in external storage instead of locally.

options.label: Save automatically in external storage instead of locally (No local copy)
Save automatically in external storage + keep local backup

settings.label: Automatically save new product photos to external storage
Automatically save product videos to external storage
Remove local file after cloud upload
settings.help: Frees local server disk space once a photo or video is safely stored in external cloud storage.

settings.label: Display external product videos on storefront product pages
Bucket / Storage Zone Name
settings.help: Enter the exact bucket name (Wasabi, AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze, GCS, MinIO), Space name (DigitalOcean), or Storage Zone name (BunnyCDN).

settings.label: Storage Region
settings.help: Provider region code: e.g. us-east-1 or eu-central-1 (Wasabi/AWS S3), auto (Cloudflare R2), nyc3 or sgp1 (DigitalOcean), us-west-004 (Backblaze B2), de or ny (BunnyCDN).

settings.label: Cloudflare Account ID
settings.help: Required for Cloudflare R2 and Cloudflare REST API. Copy your 32-character Account ID from the Cloudflare Dashboard -> R2 Object Storage overview sidebar.

settings.label: Custom API / S3 Endpoint URL (Optional)
settings.help: Leave blank to auto-resolve for Wasabi, AWS S3, Cloudflare, DigitalOcean, Backblaze, BunnyCDN, and GCS. Required for MinIO, Custom S3, and Custom HTTP REST API.

settings.label: Public CDN / Custom Domain URL (Optional)
settings.help: Optional public delivery domain (e.g. Cloudflare R2 Custom Domain, CloudFront URL, or BunnyCDN Pull Zone https://yourzone.b-cdn.net) used to serve product photos & videos.

settings.label: Remote Folder Prefix
settings.help: Folder prefix inside your bucket where product photos and videos will be organized (default: catalog).
